name: Unorthodox Blocks Wisconsin 2025
information:
This competition has very few official WCA events and is primarily focused on unofficial events. You can find information on unofficial events [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UnorthodoxBlocksWisconsin2025#49784-unofficial-events-info-must-read). If you are a new competitor or are looking for a full day of official competing, we recommend you check out one of our [many other local competitions](https://www.midwestcubing.org/upcoming-competitions).

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association.](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)
